notes: *saying* is added under rule 5: no token of this verse licenses it, and λέγει stands in ROM.4.6 already spent on *pronounceth*. Rule 37 is ruled out — this is not a versification difference but a word the ASV supplies to introduce the Psalm quotation.
Giving *they* to ὧν as its own antecedent instead of to Μακάριοι remains defensible; rule 68 puts the supplied subject with the predicate where the clause expresses no subject of its own.
Both αἱ are unrepresented: the possessive relative *whose* occupies the determiner slot (rule 20's displacement), so nothing is left for either article.
